enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Place eggs on plate. Pick up bread. Place in toaster. Press toaster lever. Remove toast. Spread butter on toast. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for work, getting dressed and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out shirt. Pick out pants. Pick out socks. Pick out underwear. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Pick out shoes. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Place laptop, notebook, pen inside. Zip backpack. Pick up phone and keys. Place them in pocket. Exit bedroom.

Put on jacket. Pick up backpack. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record blood pressure. Administer medication. Walk to patient room 2. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record temperature. Administer medication.

Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Step inside. Close door. Lock door. Remove jacket. Remove shoes. Put down backpack.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Turn off light. Exit living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and using computer, using fan instead of air conditioner to avoid peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on fan. Open computer. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser and check emails. Open document. Type. Save document. Open social media. Scroll. Close social media. Open video. Watch video. Close video. Shut down computer. Turn off fan. Turn off light. Lie on bed.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Curl up. Breathe slowly.
